metadata.evidencePolicy: Both groups receive identical frozen reference facts; agent runs the measured production prompt and tools, augmented by the shared offline contract
metadata.deterministicPolicy: Agent may refuse before the model when the existing project fixed-expense minimum exceeds the request budget; zero calls require an independently verified arithmetic witness
metadata.visitRequirementPolicy: Agent API receives per-place minimum visit durations mapped from the exact frozen public reference facts already shared with both models. No hidden expect labels or scores are used. This measures the structured-constraint workflow, including caller-to-server fact binding.
metadata.baselinePolicy: One model request, raw JSON, no repair and no server factual normalization; revision patch merged without silently accepting out-of-scope keys
metadata.scoringPolicy: Independent Node scorer; reference routes and budget floors; no application validator imports; no LLM judge
metadata.mapPolicy: ChinaTravel attraction subset + explicitly synthetic fixed route times/fares; zero live Amap calls; not official ChinaTravel scores
metadata.comparisonScope: Same 40-case regression after defect analysis; original holdout is now exposed, not an unseen generalization test
